lessons.title: Why Services? 🤔
lessons.description: Understand the need for shared logic and how services keep your code DRY and testable.

lessons.title: Creating Your First Service 🛠️
lessons.description: Generate a service with the CLI, mark it as injectable, and provide it in root.

lessons.title: Injecting Services into Components 💉
lessons.description: Learn constructor injection and use your service to share data between components.

lessons.title: Hierarchical Dependency Injection 🏛️
lessons.description: Explore the injector tree, service scoping, and when to provide at component level.

lessons.title: Advanced Service Patterns 🧪
lessons.description: Use services for state management, observables, and best practices for scalable apps.
